name: Chemosh
overview: Chemosh was the idol worshiped by the Moabites, Ammonites, and Amorites, as reflected in Scripture. The Israelites confronted the Moabites with the challenge of possessing land given by their God rather than Chemosh (Judges 11:24). Jeremiah's prophecy condemns the trust placed in Chemosh, predicting captivity for the idol and its priests along with the people of Moab, who would be ashamed of their false confidence (Jeremiah 48:7, 13, 46). This illustrates the futility of trusting in idols instead of the one true God.
